title.value: UNESCO-TWAS/FAPESP Call for Proposals for Postdoctoral Fellowships for Researchers from Developing Countries
title.evidence_quote: UNESCO-TWAS/FAPESP Call for Proposals for Postdoctoral Fellowships for Researchers from Developing Countries

seniority: Postdoctoral researchers (doctorate within the last seven years)
qualifications: Native and permanent resident of a country classified by TWAS as developing, with the exception of Brazil
Doctorate in an area of natural, applied or social sciences, applying within seven years of obtaining it
Not already in Brazil and not holding a temporary or permanent residence visa in Brazil or in any developed country
A matched supervisor in the state of São Paulo who submits the full proposal to FAPESP through SAGe
description_short: UNESCO-TWAS and FAPESP call for postdoctoral fellowships for researchers from TWAS-defined developing countries (Brazil excepted), hosted at institutions in São Paulo state. After a candidate-supervisor match, the supervisor submits the full proposal to FAPESP through SAGe.

deadline.evidence_quote: Deadline for submission of full proposals: 1 April 2027

status_evidence: TWAS postdoctoral fellowships page (seen in search results): 'Deadline for submission of full proposals: 1 April 2027'

Number of fellowships, duration and stipend not quoted here; check the official call
Researchers awarded under the previous 2023 call are not eligible; one proposal per TWAS programme per calendar year
